Test Case 3: Validate template structure and completeness

Input: Load all templates and validate their structure

Expected Output:
- All templates valid: true
- Required fields present: true (id, name, description)
- Tasks non-empty: true (all templates have tasks array with items)

Validation Logic:
1. Load all bootstrap templates
2. For each template, verify:
   - Has id field
   - Has name field
   - Has description field
   - Has tasks array with length > 0
   - All tasks have: id, description, prompt, prompt.template

Success Criteria:
- All 6 templates pass structure validation
- No templates with missing required fields
- All tasks within templates are well-formed
